events.what: Zhang claims both directions of Fuglede's conjecture fail in R^2 via 60-point sets in Z60xZ12 lifted to unions of unit squares
events.credibility_reason: An automated reviewer (Pith Review, known to the researcher only via search snippets) flags a notational error in the transference step for the spectral-but-not-tiling direction; not a knock-down (F11), but unanswered, with only v1 on arXiv and no expert uptake yet.

events.what: Shi proves Fuglede's conjecture (spectral implies tile) for unions of three intervals in R

judgement.doubts: The bullet names R and R^2; Zhang addresses only R^2, so even if correct it is a case (the earlier correction's reasoning is right). Both events are partial-tier; Zhang is chosen as the more far-reaching (a whole dimension vs. a class of three-interval sets). Had Shi been chosen the direction would be confirmed; overall the settled cases arguably go both ways. Zhang's non-tiling direction rests on a transference step flagged by an automated reviewer; the tile-not-spectral direction may stand alone. No AI in either paper.

corrections.why: F8: the status rests on Zhang's R^2 counterexample (arXiv:2607.15632); Shi's three-interval result is a separate same-tier event and remains described in the outcome.

other: kept, resting on Zhang; but Shi's three-interval case (confirmed) is also partial-tier, so the settled cases across the bullet arguably go both ways, and Zhang's non-tiling direction carries an unanswered automated-review flag on its transference step.
